text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring of El Condor Pasa's classic year has ended, and summer camp season is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing she can't just stay depressed, she decides that if she has to be worried, it's better to worry cheerfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bright and exciting summer begins with Mambo close behind!
